title: Gate owner finalization on existing cross-repository integration reconciliation

owned: Supervisor dispatch admission ladder repair for non-default registry repositories
Multi-repo registry helper for canonical GitHub slug and default branch resolution
Suppression of owned_finalize_dispatch for unreceipted foreign-repository deliveries
Deterministic starvation regression coverage for OPS-FE-REVIEW-PROOF-001 and OPS-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-MULTIREPO-RECEIPT-REPAIR-001
not_changing: No second scheduler, queue, cron, receipt store, status API, or integration path
Auto-integrator writer and lock authority not duplicated
Normal unmerged Pantheon finalization remains eligible
TaskStore authority and lifecycle state transitions untouched

criterion_1.statement: Implement the immutable plan/report referenced by this signed packet. Repair only the existing supervisor dispatch admission ladder; do not add a second scheduler, queue, cron, receipt store, status API, or integration path.
criterion_1.evidence: Repaired evaluate_task_delivery_admission in dispatch_policy.py to check is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending for OWNED_FINALIZE decisions. Reused existing multi-repo registry and canonical integration receipt validation without introducing any second scheduler, queue, cron, receipt store, or status API.

criterion_2.statement: For every configured non-default registry repository, an exact review_approved delivery with no current canonical integration receipt must not reserve owned_finalize_dispatch. It remains visible to the existing sole auto-integrator; once that existing receipt is current, normal owner closeout remains eligible.
criterion_2.evidence: Implemented is_non_default_repository_finalization_pending(config, task). For review_approved tasks targeting configured non-default repositories (such as execute-plans), admission returns eligible=False with TASK_NOT_DISPATCHABLE when unreceipted. Once a matching canonical integration receipt is recorded, owned_finalize_dispatch is admitted normally.

criterion_3.statement: Resolve target repository through the existing strict registry/receipt contract. Unknown/misconfigured repository ids, absent/malformed receipts, generation drift, changed PR/head/base or repository slug must fail closed and must not make a task appear reconciled.
criterion_3.evidence: task_has_current_canonical_integration_receipt resolves repository scope strictly via multi_repo_registry.task_repository_slug_and_default_branch. Fails closed on unknown repository ids, ambiguous/conflicting artifact paths, receipt version mismatch (!=1), invalid result (!=landed), unknown observation, receipt task_generation > current task generation, PR mismatch, head_sha mismatch, target_branch mismatch, missing merge_commit_sha, or delivery_binding mismatch.

criterion_4.statement: Add deterministic planner/admission coverage for the current OPS-FE-REVIEW-PROOF-001 binding: execute-plans PR #747/head 598101a2b62395d4c39c19df619ebb4207ea8458 with no receipt cannot consume the owner-finalize priority while OPS-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-MULTIREPO-RECEIPT-REPAIR-001 remains selectable. Cover normal unmerged Pantheon finalization and invalid/unknown registry negative controls.
criterion_4.evidence: Added test_planner_ops_fe_review_proof_unreceipted_does_not_starve_auto_integrator in test_supervisor.py and corresponding unit tests in test_dispatch_policy.py. Verifies execute-plans PR 747 / head 598101a2b62395d4c39c19df619ebb4207ea8458 with no receipt is blocked and cannot finalize, allowing OPS-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-MULTIREPO-RECEIPT-REPAIR-001 (in_progress) to be selected when max_concurrent_workers=1. Verified normal unmerged Pantheon finalization remains eligible, and verified negative controls for unknown repo, conflicting artifacts, malformed version, generation drift, repo drift, and branch drift.

criterion_5.statement: Compose with OPS-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-MULTIREPO-RECEIPT-REPAIR-001 without duplicating its writer/lock authority; rebase as needed, record exact tests/evidence, then deliver through the usual PR, independent review and sole integrator.
criterion_5.evidence: multi_repo_registry.task_repository_slug_and_default_branch helper provides clean composition without duplicating writer or lock authority. All modified artifacts compile cleanly and pass pytest.

results: all modified runtime modules compiled without syntax or lint errors
no git whitespace or patch errors

required_checks: Confirm evaluate_task_delivery_admission blocks unreceipted review_approved non-default registry tasks with task_not_dispatchable
Confirm in-progress tasks like OPS-AUTO-INTEGRATOR-MULTIREPO-RECEIPT-REPAIR-001 are not starved by unreceipted finalizations
Confirm normal unmerged Pantheon review_approved tasks remain eligible for owner-finalize dispatch
Confirm unknown registry repositories, malformed receipts, and generation drift fail closed
Confirm no second scheduler, queue, cron, or integration path was introduced
